topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for the hallmarks of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives and framing the hallmarks of cancer model.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and mutations driving proliferation and survival
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades promote continuous proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation block in hematopoietic and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how impaired terminal differentiation traps cells in proliferative progenitor states across leukemias and colorectal carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis through p53 and Bcl-2 family regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the mechanisms by which cancer cells evade programmed cell death through p53 inactivation and altered expression of Bcl-2 family regulators.

topics.label: Telomere biology, cellular senescence bypass, and replicative immortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere shortening triggers senescence via p53-mediated stress pathways and how cancer cells reactivate telomerase to achieve unlimited replicative potential.

topics.label: Cancer metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how cancer cells rewire cellular metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, Krebs cycle enzyme mutations, and epigenetic alterations driven by oncometabolites.

topics.label: Induction of angiogenesis in tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how growing tumors overcome hypoxia and nutrient limitation by shifting regulatory signals to stimulate new blood vessel formation.

topics.label: Mechanisms, detection, and genomics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the multi-step invasion-metastasis cascade, clinical monitoring using circulating tumor cells, and genomic features underlying metastatic dissemination.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and summary of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks on the integration of cancer hallmarks and invitations for student questions.
